title: An isolated prime of a finite type algebra over a field has finite residue field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $B$ be a finitely generated $k$-algebra. If $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}B$ has singleton $\{\mathfrak p\}$ open in $\operatorname{Spec}B$, then the residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=B_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], with its field extension structure from $k\to B\to\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-pc-field-extension], is finite over $k$.
